tokens.name: bg-000
tokens.usage: Console panes (save table, log) and the share-all well: a step darker than the page in dark themes, a light grey well in light ones.

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: App ground: the page behind cards and the side rail. Pure black sets it to #000000.

tokens.name: bg-200
tokens.usage: Card surface: every rounded panel, dialogs, settings cards.

tokens.name: bg-300
tokens.usage: Raised inside a card: secondary buttons, idle controls, inputs, empty activity cells, folder rows.

tokens.name: bg-400
tokens.usage: Hover on bg-300 controls, the progress track, the hatch stripe in activity cells and missing cover art.

tokens.name: surface-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs. bg-200 in Solid; in Glossy nearly opaque (94 to 96%), so a dialog always reads on its own over the page.

tokens.name: surface-well
tokens.usage: Rows set into a card: folder rows, a game's save files. bg-300 in Solid; in Glossy black at 26 to 28%, a well darker than the card.

tokens.name: surface-field
tokens.usage: Text fields, inside a line-200 border. bg-200 in Solid; black at 30% in Glossy.

tokens.name: line-100
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers: console rows, settings rows, the rail edge. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-200
tokens.usage: Control borders that must be seen: checkboxes, the switch track, inputs, the add-swatch ring. 3:1 or better on bg-000, bg-200, bg-300 and secondary-soft in every theme.

tokens.name: edge-card
tokens.usage: A card's 1px edge. Clear in Solid, where cards sit apart by surface; white at 5 to 7.5% in Glossy, where the card is see-through.

tokens.name: edge-control
tokens.usage: The 1px edge of secondary and danger buttons and icon buttons. Clear in Solid; white at 4 to 6% in Glossy.

tokens.name: edge-console
tokens.usage: The 1px edge of console panes (the save table, the log). Clear in Solid; white at 5 to 6% in Glossy.

tokens.name: edge-well
tokens.usage: The 1px edge of a well (surface-well). Clear in Solid; white at 4 to 5% in Glossy.

tokens.name: edge-dialog
tokens.usage: A dialog's 1px edge. Clear in Solid; white at 7 to 9% in Glossy.

tokens.name: edge-art
tokens.usage: A 1px ring around cover art and the hero, outside the picture. Clear in Solid; white at 6 to 9% in Glossy, so art stays apart from the backdrop.

tokens.name: dot-ring
tokens.usage: The ring that cuts a rail dot out of its icon. bg-100 in Solid; nearly opaque in Glossy, so the dot stays clear over the backdrop.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg-000 to bg-400, secondary-soft and primary-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, blurbs, table paths, ghost buttons. 6:1 or better on bg-000 to bg-300, secondary-soft and primary-soft; 4.5:1 on bg-400.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, column headers, rail icons at rest, placeholders. 4.6:1 or better on bg-000 to bg-300, secondary-soft and primary-soft.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The theme's first colour. The one primary button per view, progress fills, the busiest activity days, checkbox and switch fills, the console prompt, the logo and the focus ring. 4.5:1 or better on bg-000 to bg-300 in every theme.

tokens.name: primary-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for primary buttons.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text, ticks and icons on primary and primary-strong fills (7:1 in dark themes, white in light ones).

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for primary notices, such as the Zip ready panel; primary text on it is 4.5:1 or better.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: The theme's second colour. Where you are and what you picked: the current rail and settings icon, the selected tab's icon, tab counts, and 2 to 4 hour activity days. 3:1 or better on every surface, secondary-soft included.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text on secondary fills, such as the tab count chip.

tokens.name: secondary-soft
tokens.usage: Selection ground: selected table rows, ticked share and import items, the current rail button, the selected tab and settings section. ink, ink-muted and every status colour read on it.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Status, fixed in every theme: Synced, Upload pending, Newer in cloud, and OK log tags. Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Background for ok chips.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Status, fixed in every theme: Needs you (Conflict, Held for review, Files in use, Saves not found). Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Background for warn chips, the missing-drive message and the Needs-you banner.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Status, fixed in every theme: Blocked, refused folders and destructive buttons only. Never Conflict.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background for Blocked chips, refused-folder messages and error log lines.

tokens.name: play
tokens.usage: Status, fixed in every theme: Playing, and the now-playing dot on the rail. Nothing else. Spotify's green in dark mode; a deeper green in light mode for 4.5:1 (the owner, 1 Oct 2026).

tokens.name: play-soft
tokens.usage: Background for the Playing chip.

tokens.name: neutral
tokens.usage: Status, fixed in every theme: Backup only and Not available, on bg-300 chips.

tokens.name: ok-art
tokens.usage: A ok badge on cover art (tiles, the hero), in both surfaces: in dark themes a deep tint of ok at 82%, 4.5:1 or better over any art; light themes keep the opaque ok-soft.

tokens.name: warn-art
tokens.usage: A warn badge on cover art (tiles, the hero), in both surfaces: in dark themes a deep tint of warn at 82%, 4.5:1 or better over any art; light themes keep the opaque warn-soft.

tokens.name: danger-art
tokens.usage: A danger badge on cover art (tiles, the hero), in both surfaces: in dark themes a deep tint of danger at 82%, 4.5:1 or better over any art; light themes keep the opaque danger-soft.

tokens.name: play-art
tokens.usage: A play badge on cover art (tiles, the hero), in both surfaces: in dark themes a deep tint of play at 82%, 4.5:1 or better over any art; light themes keep the opaque play-soft.

tokens.name: neutral-art
tokens.usage: A neutral badge on cover art: in dark themes the theme's tint at 10% lightness and 88%, 4.5:1 or better over any art; light themes keep bg-300.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind dialogs.

tokens.name: art-scrim
tokens.usage: Fixed in every theme: the fade over hero cover art so on-art text reads, and hover on glass buttons.

tokens.name: on-art
tokens.usage: Fixed in every theme: text and icons that sit on cover art (hero title, eyebrow, glass buttons, playtime chip).

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Fixed in every theme: the dark glass behind buttons and chips on cover art, and the empty hero.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: Fixed in every theme: the 1px edge of glass buttons and chips on cover art.

styles.name: hero-title
styles.usage: The game name on the hero banner. One per screen.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Screen titles: Library, a game's saves, Settings.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your save is backed up and matches the laptop.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Buttons, row titles, game names in lists.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata under a title, chip text, greeting subline.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Rail and sidebar group labels, uppercase.

styles.name: mono-stat
styles.usage: Big numbers: playtime, total save size, version count.

styles.name: mono-body
styles.usage: Console table cells, paths, sizes, hashes.

styles.name: mono-small
styles.usage: Log lines, column headers (uppercase), key hints.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside chips; stacked caption under a title.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between pill tabs, between buttons in a group.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Console cell padding (horizontal); list row gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in the launcher grid; card inner padding on small cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card inner padding; hero text inset.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutters; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between the header and the first row of cards.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, console row selection, key hints.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Activity cells, cover art in lists, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, game tiles, the hero banner, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button, pill tab, status chip and the progress track.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and tooltips only. Cards stay flat: they sit apart by surface, not shadow.

tokens.name: lift-card
tokens.usage: Glossy only: a lit top edge on cards over the backdrop (inset 0 1px 0, white at 4 to 5%). None in Solid, where cards stay flat.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: The collapsed launcher side rail.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons and pill tabs; the icon button is a 40px circle.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Console table rows.
